notice: Calibration/evaluation only. Neither feature collection nor diagnose.py may read this file. Runtime values must be re-measured on the target host.

C00.name: 正常负对照
C00.proof: Uniform row counts, contiguous SIMD kernel, one parallel region; no injected defect. This does not prove global optimality.

C01.name: 未向量化
C01.proof: Identical CSR, B layout, row ownership and loop order. Scalar translation unit disables auto-vectorization. Verify packed/scalar arithmetic in disassembly.

C02.name: 循环顺序不佳
C02.proof: Both variants use the SAME non-vectorizing translation unit. Only f/q loop order changes. Improvement establishes loop-order sensitivity, not DRAM bandwidth saturation.

C03.name: 线程负载不均
C03.proof: First 1/8 of rows contain 64x as many nonzeros as remaining rows. Contiguous equal-row partition puts disproportionate work on early workers; nnz-balanced boundaries change only row ownership.

C04.name: 并行任务过碎
C04.proof: Same SIMD row kernel and uniform work; baseline enters one OpenMP region per 16 rows, reference enters one per SpMM. No sleeps or dummy work.
